# Embracers vd: ”Positiva trender som vi har sett under en tid”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-11  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon morning show from 11 November 2026. US markets were under pressure: the Nasdaq fell, Microsoft dropped after Anthropic launched a challenge to Office, Nvidia was hit by a scandal around Jensen Huang, and a hot US CPI print pushed rates higher. Stockholm meanwhile hit record levels, led by the banks. The main segment covers Embracer's strong Q2, with 20% organic growth against analyst expectations of zero and reiterated cash EBIT guidance. The hosts also cover New Wave's margin improvement, Vestas' weak report and the Munters and Proact capital markets days.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 EMBRAC-B — Embracer | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

20% organic growth vs ~0% expected, cash EBIT 203 MSEK, FY guide reiterated; hosts positive but waiting to see how the stock reacts.

#### Reasoning

A large organic beat against consensus (20% vs 0%) and cash EBIT ahead of plan at the half year support a positive reaction. Hosts quip 'One does not simply stop Embracer' but say 'we'll see how the stock reacts', so this is positive without an explicit buy. CEO is bullish on the LOTR IP and sees the GTA launch as net positive. Much of the 1bn SEK cash EBIT remains in H2, so there is execution risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if H2 releases fail to deliver the remaining ~750 MSEK cash EBIT
- if FY cash EBIT guidance is cut
- if the GTA launch crowds out consumer spending on other games

> *"Nåt som särskilt sticker ut är den organiska försäljningstillväxten på 20 %. Analytikerna hade förutspått en nolltillväxt. Vi får se hur den här aktien reagerar."*

---

### 🟠 NEWA-B — New Wave | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Organic growth only 3%, but margin up to 13.2%; investment pace to slow, which could lift margins toward the 20% target.

#### Reasoning

Hosts were disappointed by organic growth versus other consumer names. They saw the margin expansion despite dilutive acquisitions and heavy warehouse and marketing investment as the big positive. CEO Torsten Jansson says investment will slow, which hosts think should feed through to further margin improvement.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margin improvement stalls
- if organic growth stays weak
- if the investment pace does not slow

> *"Det stora positiva är ju att de får ändå ut högre marginaler nu trots att tillväxten inte riktigt är där."*

---

### ⛔ VWS — Vestas | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Report clearly weaker than expected; hosts expect a tough trading day.

#### Reasoning

The hosts flag the report as clearly below expectations and expect a near-term negative share reaction. This is a short-term caution, not a structural thesis.

#### Sell Triggers

- if guidance is maintained and the market shrugs off the miss

> *"Den ser klart svagare ut än förväntat. Gigantisk, ett bolag på Köpenhamnsbörsen. Så de kan nog få det lite tufft idag också."*

---

### 🟠 MTRS — Munters | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Data center order boom (+100% for 6 quarters) not yet converted to growth and margin; new CEO at today's CMD could set new targets.

#### Reasoning

Hosts call Munters a big data center winner but note the orders have not shown up in revenue and margins. The CMD under new CEO Stefan Aspa is the near-term catalyst to watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the CMD fails to show a path to margin conversion
- if data center orders slow

> *"Det är Munters som är en stor datacentervinnare som har tagit jättemycket order."*

---
